import * as ARA3D from '../src/index'; import * as THREE from 'three'; // ---------- State ---------- const paletteState = { saturation: 0.45, lightness: 0.20, seedHue: 0.10, // start hue in [0..1) }; // You can keep this constant unless you want a control for it too. const PHI = 0.618033988749895; let viewer = null; let bimData = null; let levelToInstances = null; let currentGroup = null; // Optional: keep the last-built instance list so we can rebuild quickly // without re-querying / recreating other stuff. let baseInstancesByLevel = null; // Map> function generateRandomMaterialsForMap(map, { saturation, lightness, seedHue }) { const out = new Map(); let h = seedHue; for (const key of map.keys()) { h = (h + PHI) % 1.0; const color = new THREE.Color().setHSL(h, saturation, lightness); const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color, roughness: 0.85, metalness: 0.0, flatShading: true, side: THREE.DoubleSide, }); out.set(key, material); } return out; } function buildInstancesWithMaterials() { const materialsByLevel = generateRandomMaterialsForMap(levelToInstances, paletteState); const instances = []; for (const [levelKey, instGroup] of levelToInstances) { const material = materialsByLevel.get(levelKey); if (!material) continue; for (const inst of instGroup) { // clone + attach material (avoids mutating original) instances.push({ ...inst, material }); } } return instances; } function rebuildSceneGeometry() { if (!viewer || !bimData || !levelToInstances) return; // Remove previous group if present if (currentGroup) { viewer.remove?.(currentGroup); // if Viewer supports remove // If it doesn't, you can fall back to currentGroup.parent.remove(currentGroup) if it's a THREE.Object3D in a scene. // e.g.: viewer.scene?.remove(currentGroup); currentGroup = null; } const instances = buildInstancesWithMaterials(); currentGroup = bimData.rebuildGeometry(instances); viewer.add(currentGroup); } function debounce(fn, ms) { let t = null; return (...args) => { clearTimeout(t); t = setTimeout(() => fn(...args), ms); }; } const rebuildDebounced = debounce(rebuildSceneGeometry, 60); // ---------- UI wiring ---------- function setText(id, txt) { document.getElementById(id).textContent = txt; } function syncUI() { const sat = document.getElementById('sat'); const lit = document.getElementById('lit'); const seed = document.getElementById('seed'); sat.value = String(paletteState.saturation); lit.value = String(paletteState.lightness); seed.value = String(paletteState.seedHue); setText('satVal', paletteState.saturation.toFixed(2)); setText('litVal', paletteState.lightness.toFixed(2)); setText('seedVal', paletteState.seedHue.toFixed(3)); } function bindUI() { const sat = document.getElementById('sat'); const lit = document.getElementById('lit'); const seed = document.getElementById('seed'); const shuffle = document.getElementById('shuffle'); const reset = document.getElementById('reset'); sat.addEventListener('input', () => { paletteState.saturation = Number(sat.value); setText('satVal', paletteState.saturation.toFixed(2)); rebuildDebounced(); }); lit.addEventListener('input', () => { paletteState.lightness = Number(lit.value); setText('litVal', paletteState.lightness.toFixed(2)); rebuildDebounced(); }); seed.addEventListener('input', () => { paletteState.seedHue = Number(seed.value); setText('seedVal', paletteState.seedHue.toFixed(3)); rebuildDebounced(); }); shuffle.addEventListener('click', () => { paletteState.seedHue = Math.random(); syncUI(); rebuildSceneGeometry(); }); reset.addEventListener('click', () => { paletteState.saturation = 0.45; paletteState.lightness = 0.20; paletteState.seedHue = 0.10; syncUI(); rebuildSceneGeometry(); }); } // ---------- Main ---------- async function runExample() { viewer = new ARA3D.Viewer(); const loader = new ARA3D.BimOpenSchemaLoader(); console.time('Loading .bos file'); bimData = await loader.load('/ara3d-webgl/Snowdon Towers Sample Architectural.bos', { loadParameters: true }); console.timeEnd('Loading .bos file'); levelToInstances = bimData.Query.LevelToInstances(); // UI syncUI(); bindUI(); // Initial build rebuildSceneGeometry(); } runExample();
